entities.summary: Ludwig Nissen was a New York gemstone dealer and philanthropist. He lived in Brooklyn for many years and was well known in the Brooklyn community, particularly for the lavish mansion he built on St. Mark's Avenue. He is also known for founding the Nordsee Museum in Husum, Germany.
